an10.16:1.1: akkhāyatī ti. XVI. Dasa yime bhikkhave puggalā āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa. Katame dasa? Tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, paccekasambuddho, ubhatobhāgavimutto. paññāvimutto, kāyasakkhi, diṭṭhippatto, saddhāvimutto, dhammānusārī, saddhānusārī, gotrabhū. Ime kho bhikkhave dasa puggalā āhuneyyā . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā ti.
